candidates.name: Ovarian cyst with secondary infection

contradict_spans: on incision of the cyst wall purulent fluid was noted

contradict_spans: the mass was excised intact, the tubo-ovarian structures were preserved
candidates.why: A hydrosalpinx with torsion could present as a cystic mass with acute symptoms, although the absence of reported torsion makes this less likely.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis is a rare but possible cause of acute abdominal pain and a cystic mass, warranting consideration in the differential diagnosis.
